title: Beyond LLM Wrappers: Context Engineering and the Three-Engine Architecture for Reliable Financial AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.39230v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial AI systems must support decision-bearing questions involving payments, collections, cash flow, and compliance while ensuring numerical accuracy, traceability, and auditability. Large language models (LLMs) enable natural language interaction but cannot independently guarantee reproducible calculations or evidence-grounded recommendations. We present a production-grounded architecture integrating three components: a financial knowledge graph for enterprise relationships, temporal context, and provenance; a deterministic optimization engine for financial calculations and decisions; and a multi-agent LLM layer for intent interpretation, task orchestration, explanation, and claim validation. A coordination layer, termed context engineering, selects, ranks, composes, and validates query-specific context across ERP systems, tools, and tenants. translated_title: 超越LLM包装器：面向可靠金融AI的上下文工程与三引擎架构
translated_abstract: 金融AI系统必须支持涉及支付、收款、现金流和合规性的决策类问题，同时确保数值准确性、可追溯性和可审计性。大语言模型（LLM）虽然实现了自然语言交互，但无法独立保证可复现的计算或有证据支撑的推荐。我们提出了一种源于生产实践的架构，集成了三个组件：用于表达企业关系、时间上下文和溯源信息的金融知识图谱；用于金融计算与决策的确定性优化引擎；以及用于意图理解、任务编排、解释生成和论断验证的多智能体LLM层。一个名为“上下文工程”的协调层，负责跨ERP系统、工具和租户对查询特定的上下文进行选择、排序、组合和验证。基于约11个月内15个部署的观察，单智能体管道……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种融合金融知识图谱、确定性优化引擎与多智能体LLM层的“三引擎架构”，并通过上下文工程协调层实现可靠、可追溯、可审计的金融AI系统。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a "three-engine architecture" integrating a financial knowledge graph, a deterministic optimization engine, and a multi-agent LLM layer, coordinated through context engineering to achieve reliable, traceable, and auditable financial AI systems.
